nlnet.abstract: SHARDEX mirrors a codebase, shatters it into content-addressed shards, and forges a shard into a FLAME game engine arena. nlnet.use: Game developers can use SHARDEX to port existing codebases to the FLAME engine, enabling cross-platform deployment and deterministic replay.
nlnet.comparison: Unlike existing game porting tools, SHARDEX uses content-addressed sharding for deterministic, verifiable builds. The golden-state hash provides mathematical proof of correctness.
nlnet.challenges: The browser forge step requires Node+puppeteer+Chrome which adds complexity. Ensuring deterministic output across platforms requires careful handling of floating-point and timing.
